It requires a fishing level of 8 in order to catch. {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Map== {|class="wikitable" |style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Fish Zone Forest West.png|center|500px|class=responsive-image]] |- |style="text-align:center;"|Forest West - Fish Zones. |} {{clear}} ==Gifting== {{PAGENAME}} is a universally '''disliked''' gift item, with the following exceptions: {{Gifting |like=Andy, Demetrius, Elliott, Evelyn, Gus, Jodi, Leah, Olivia, Pierre, Robin, Willy |neutral=Linus |hate=Abigail, Claire, Clint, George, Haley, Jas, Martin, Maru, Pam, Sebastian, Shane, Sophia, Vincent }} ==Fish Pond== {{#lst:Fish|King Salmon}} ==Recipes== {{PAGENAME}} is not specifically used in any artisan, cooking, or crafting recipes but can be used in recipes calling for "Any Fish." ==Bundles== When '''"SVE Bundles"''' is selected in the [[Configuration Options]], {{PAGENAME}} is required to complete the {{Bundle|Specialty fish|32|y}}. If '''"Hard SVE Bundles"''' is selected, 3 King Salmon are required to complete the bundle. ==Quests== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any quests. ==Tailoring== {{DyePot|white}} When used in dyeing, {{PAGENAME}} produces a white color. {{Navbox Fish}} [[Category:Fish]] [[zh:帝王鲑]]
